result.brief: 提出隐式空间预见框架：训练动作条件空间世界模型预测3D手部点运动与视觉特征变化，再冻结并对齐策略查询与世界模型预测查询，将空间动力学注入策略潜空间，部署时仅保留策略。
result.reason: Learns action-conditioned spatial world model and aligns policy latents with predictive world queries; representation-level contribution, though main evaluation is dexterous manipulation policy.
